best_idea: Keep one threat table per creature and pick its target by three keys in order (can it be attacked now, is it taunting, how much threat), switching only when a challenger is clearly above the current one: above 110% for a melee source, above 130% from any range.
decision_why: Take the three-key ordering and the two-ratio hysteresis, which give stable many-on-one targeting for MAX_ATTACKERS = 3; fix the taunt rank (per source, not per effect), the up-to-1 s switch lag (re-select when a change crosses the ratio) and the per-entry visibility checks on every re-selection. Clean-room only (copyleft).
acceptance: In a one-boss test with three attackers, a ranged healer at 115% of the tank's threat does not take aggro; at 135% it does on the same server tick; a melee dealer at 115% takes aggro; a second taunt takes aggro while the first stays on the list, and no source is left at NONE or DETAUNT by a stacked taunt.
